title: Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming

scheme.name: Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming
scheme.summary: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Caste farmers by providing cash incentives for high-quality seeds, modern farming techniques, and agricultural mechanization to enhance productivity and profitability.
eligibility: The applicant must be a farmer.
The applicant must be from Gujarat state.
The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
The applicant must be a householder.
The farmer must be engaged in sugarcane cultivation.
Farmers applying for the 10% incentive must demonstrate excellent production using high-quality seeds, agricultural inputs, and modern farming practices.
scheme.benefits: Assistance for sugarcane sowing is ₹10,000/- per Hectare and 10% extra benefit per metric ton for production exceeding 70 metric Tons/Hectares.
documents: Undertaking Form (in case of joint ownership)

summary.value: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Caste farmers by providing cash incentives for high-quality seeds, modern farming techniques, and agricultural mechanization to enhance productivity and profitability.
summary.quote: The scheme "Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support Scheduled Caste farmers by providing cash incentives for high-quality seeds, modern farming techniques, and agricultural mechanization. The scheme encourages farmers to enhance productivity and profitability.
